caption:
Letting AI reply to your Google reviews? Add a human check.

This n8n workflow drafts a reply to each new review, emails the owner the draft with an approve link, and pauses on a Wait node. One tap resumes the workflow and posts the reply. Skip it and nothing goes out.

Real n8n run. The incoming review, the AI draft and the Google post are simulated and labelled; the approval email and the pause-and-resume are real.
